book: Latin scholarly treatise in three parts (Pars prima to Pars tertia) by Friedrich Spanheim, Exercitationes de authore Epistolæ ad Hebræos (Heidelberg 1659), each part divided into numbered Caput chapters with argument rubrics, preceded by a dedication, a preface and the privilege, and followed by an index.
